# Service & Outreach

## Committees and Organizations

```{r service, results='asis'}
library(lubridate)
vroom::vroom("data/committees-service.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    date_parsed = lubridate::my(start),
    start_fmt   = format(date_parsed, "%b. %Y")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(date_parsed)) %>%
  mutate(line = glue::glue("- {with}, {where} ({start_fmt} - {stop})")) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```
